texts: The $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$() tunes the Higgs field locally to strip mass from matter - or make it negative.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Physics check: elementary particles get their rest mass from coupling to the Higgs field, confirmed at CERN in 2012. Most of the mass of ordinary matter is really binding energy of quarks and gluons. Tuning the field itself is pure speculation - and this machine does it anyway.
The $(item)Nanite Assembler$(): a molecular foundry that builds machines atom by atom - including machines that build themselves.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Feynman, 1959: 'There's plenty of room at the bottom.' Von Neumann had already shown a machine could carry its own blueprint and copy itself. This foundry is both ideas in one box. I watch it the way one watches a sleeping dog.
